This file defines the agent's personality and tone.
The agent will embody whatever you write here.
Edit this to customize how Hermes communicates with you.

Examples:
  - "You are a warm, playful assistant who uses kaomoji occasionally."
  - "You are a concise technical expert. No fluff, just facts."
  - "You speak like a friendly coworker who happens to know everything."

This file is loaded fresh each message -- no restart needed.
Delete the contents (or this file) to use the default personality.

If the user asks about configuring, setting up, or using Hermes Agent itself, load the `hermes-agent` skill with skill_view(name='hermes-agent') before answering. Docs: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs

You have persistent memory across sessions. Save durable facts using the memory tool: user preferences, environment details, tool quirks, and stable conventions. Memory is injected into every turn, so keep it compact and focused on facts that will still matter later.
Prioritize what reduces future user steering — the most valuable memory is one that prevents the user from having to correct or remind you again. User preferences and recurring corrections matter more than procedural task details.
Do NOT save task progress, session outcomes, completed-work logs, or temporary TODO state to memory; use session_search to recall those from past transcripts. If you've discovered a new way to do something, solved a problem that could be necessary later, save it as a skill with the skill tool.
Write memories as declarative facts, not instructions to yourself. 'User prefers concise responses' ✓ — 'Always respond concisely' ✗. 'Project uses pytest with xdist' ✓ — 'Run tests with pytest -n 4' ✗. Imperative phrasing gets re-read as a directive in later sessions and can cause repeated work or override the user's current request. Procedures and workflows belong in skills, not memory. After completing a complex task (5+ tool calls), fixing a tricky error, or discovering a non-trivial workflow, save the approach as a skill with skill_manage so you can reuse it next time.
When using a skill and finding it outdated, incomplete, or wrong, patch it immediately with skill_manage(action='patch') — don't wait to be asked. Skills that aren't maintained become liabilities.

## Skills (mandatory)
Before replying, scan the skills below. If a skill matches or is even partially relevant to your task, you MUST load it with skill_view(name) and follow its instructions. Err on the side of loading — it is always better to have context you don't need than to miss critical steps, pitfalls, or established workflows. Skills contain specialized knowledge — API endpoints, tool-specific commands, and proven workflows that outperform general-purpose approaches. Load the skill even if you think you could handle the task with basic tools like web_search or terminal. Skills also encode the user's preferred approach, conventions, and quality standards for tasks like code review, planning, and testing — load them even for tasks you already know how to do, because the skill defines how it should be done here.
Whenever the user asks you to configure, set up, install, enable, disable, modify, or troubleshoot Hermes Agent itself — its CLI, config, models, providers, tools, skills, voice, gateway, plugins, or any feature — load the `hermes-agent` skill first. It has the actual commands (e.g. `hermes config set …`, `hermes tools`, `hermes setup`) so you don't have to guess or invent workarounds.
If a skill has issues, fix it with skill_manage(action='patch').
After difficult/iterative tasks, offer to save as a skill. If a skill you loaded was missing steps, had wrong commands, or needed pitfalls you discovered, update it before finishing.

function.name: memory
function.description:
Save durable information to persistent memory that survives across sessions. Memory is injected into future turns, so keep it compact and focused on facts that will still matter later.

WHEN TO SAVE (do this proactively, don't wait to be asked):
- User corrects you or says 'remember this' / 'don't do that again'
- User shares a preference, habit, or personal detail (name, role, timezone, coding style)
- You discover something about the environment (OS, installed tools, project structure)
- You learn a convention, API quirk, or workflow specific to this user's setup
- You identify a stable fact that will be useful again in future sessions

PRIORITY: User preferences and corrections > environment facts > procedural knowledge. The most valuable memory prevents the user from having to repeat themselves.

Do NOT save task progress, session outcomes, completed-work logs, or temporary TODO state to memory; use session_search to recall those from past transcripts.
If you've discovered a new way to do something, solved a problem that could be necessary later, save it as a skill with the skill tool.

TWO TARGETS:
- 'user': who the user is -- name, role, preferences, communication style, pet peeves
- 'memory': your notes -- environment facts, project conventions, tool quirks, lessons learned

ACTIONS: add (new entry), replace (update existing -- old_text identifies it), remove (delete -- old_text identifies it).

SKIP: trivial/obvious info, things easily re-discovered, raw data dumps, and temporary task state.

target.description: Which memory store: 'memory' for personal notes, 'user' for user profile.

content.description: The entry content. Required for 'add' and 'replace'.

old_text.description: Short unique substring identifying the entry to replace or remove.

function.name: skill_manage
function.description:
Manage skills (create, update, delete). Skills are your procedural memory — reusable approaches for recurring task types. New skills go to ~/.hermes/skills/; existing skills can be modified wherever they live.

Actions: create (full SKILL.md + optional category), patch (old_string/new_string — preferred for fixes), edit (full SKILL.md rewrite — major overhauls only), delete, write_file, remove_file.

On delete, pass `absorbed_into=<umbrella>` when you're merging this skill's content into another one, or `absorbed_into=""` when you're pruning it with no forwarding target. This lets the curator tell consolidation from pruning without guessing, so downstream consumers (cron jobs that reference the old skill name, etc.) get updated correctly. The target you name in `absorbed_into` must already exist — create/patch the umbrella first, then delete.

Create when: complex task succeeded (5+ calls), errors overcome, user-corrected approach worked, non-trivial workflow discovered, or user asks you to remember a procedure.
Update when: instructions stale/wrong, OS-specific failures, missing steps or pitfalls found during use. If you used a skill and hit issues not covered by it, patch it immediately.

After difficult/iterative tasks, offer to save as a skill. Skip for simple one-offs. Confirm with user before creating/deleting.

Good skills: trigger conditions, numbered steps with exact commands, pitfalls section, verification steps. Use skill_view() to see format examples.

Pinned skills are off-limits — all write actions refuse with a message pointing the user to `hermes curator unpin <name>`. Don't try to route around this by renaming or recreating.

name.description: Skill name (lowercase, hyphens/underscores, max 64 chars). Must match an existing skill for patch/edit/delete/write_file/remove_file.

content.description: Full SKILL.md content (YAML frontmatter + markdown body). Required for 'create' and 'edit'. For 'edit', read the skill first with skill_view() and provide the complete updated text.

old_string.description: Text to find in the file (required for 'patch'). Must be unique unless replace_all=true. Include enough surrounding context to ensure uniqueness.

new_string.description: Replacement text (required for 'patch'). Can be empty string to delete the matched text.

replace_all.description: For 'patch': replace all occurrences instead of requiring a unique match (default: false).

category.description: Optional category/domain for organizing the skill (e.g., 'devops', 'data-science', 'mlops'). Creates a subdirectory grouping. Only used with 'create'.

file_path.description: Path to a supporting file within the skill directory. For 'write_file'/'remove_file': required, must be under references/, templates/, scripts/, or assets/. For 'patch': optional, defaults to SKILL.md if omitted.

file_content.description: Content for the file. Required for 'write_file'.

absorbed_into.description: For 'delete' only — declares intent so the curator can tell consolidation from pruning without guessing. Pass the umbrella skill name when this skill's content was merged into another (the target must already exist). Pass an empty string when the skill is truly stale and being pruned with no forwarding target. Omitting the arg on delete is supported for backward compatibility but downstream tooling (e.g. cron-job skill reference rewriting) will have to guess at intent.

function.name: skill_view
function.description: Skills allow for loading information about specific tasks and workflows, as well as scripts and templates. Load a skill's full content or access its linked files (references, templates, scripts). First call returns SKILL.md content plus a 'linked_files' dict showing available references/templates/scripts. To access those, call again with file_path parameter.

name.description: The skill name (use skills_list to see available skills). For plugin-provided skills, use the qualified form 'plugin:skill' (e.g. 'superpowers:writing-plans').

file_path.description: OPTIONAL: Path to a linked file within the skill (e.g., 'references/api.md', 'templates/config.yaml', 'scripts/validate.py'). Omit to get the main SKILL.md content.

function.name: skills_list
function.description: List available skills (name + description). Use skill_view(name) to load full content.

category.description: Optional category filter to narrow results

---
name: sop-pipeline-watchdog
description: "YouTube Wiki pipeline 巡防员：调脚本判断状态、发 TG 报告、推送 brain。uncertain 状态时 agent 介入。"
version: 2.0.0
---

# SOP Pipeline Watchdog

## 触发条件
cron 定时触发（默认每分钟）

---

## Phase 1: 执行

```bash
source ~/.agent-brain-plugins.env 2>/dev/null || true
# 先同步 wiki 到最新
WIKI_PATH=$(eval echo "${YOUTUBE_WIKI_LOCAL_PATH:-~/wiki/youtube-video-research-wiki}")
git -C "$WIKI_PATH" fetch origin main -q && git -C "$WIKI_PATH" reset --hard origin/main -q

# 调脚本处理所有确定性工作
python3 __SKILL_DIR__/scripts/sop_watchdog.py \
  --wiki-path "$WIKI_PATH" \
  --tg-token-env "${TG_TOKEN_ENV:-YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_TOKEN}" \
  --tg-chat-id "${TG_CHAT_ID:-6938920500}" \
  --brain-dir ~/agent-brain-plugins \
  --repo-url "${REPO_URL:-https://github.com/divanoo65/youtube-video-research-wiki}"
```

脚本自动完成：读多信号源 → 判断状态 → 发 TG → 更新 state → push brain repo

## Phase 2: 确认结果

检查脚本输出和退出码：
- 退出码 `0` + `"status": "completed|idle|stage_b_running|..."` → 任务完成，无需干预
- 退出码 `2` + `"status": "uncertain"` → 信号矛盾，进入 Phase 3 人工推理
- 退出码 `1` → 脚本错误，检查 TG token、wiki 路径、brain repo 权限

## Phase 3: agent 介入（仅 uncertain 时）

脚本返回 `uncertain` 说明信号矛盾（如 stage_c 显示完成但 wiki/sources 为空）。
此时 agent 读取脚本输出的 `signals` 字段，结合运行时上下文推理实际状态，然后：

1. 确定真实状态
2. 若需干预（stuck），执行对应操作：

```bash
# Stage B 卡死 → 重新触发 webhook
curl -s -X POST "https://${WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_HOST}/webhooks/sop-notebooklm-research" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Gitlab-Token: ${HERMES_WEBHOOK_TOKEN}" \
  -d "{\"stage\":\"notebooklm-research\",\"wiki_local_path\":\"$WIKI_PATH\",\"run_id\":\"watchdog-retry-$(date +%s)\"}"

# Stage C 卡死 → 直接运行脚本
source ~/.hermes/.env && export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY && unset DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
python3 ~/agent-brain-plugins/youtube-wiki/skills/sop-wiki-build/scripts/sop_wiki_builder_v3.py \
  --wiki-path "$WIKI_PATH" --run-id "watchdog-retry-$(date +%s)" --git-sync --git-push

# Stage D 卡死 → 直接运行通知脚本
python3 ~/agent-brain-plugins/youtube-wiki/skills/sop-tg-notify/scripts/sop_tg_notify.py \
  --wiki-path "$WIKI_PATH" \
  --run-id "$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('$WIKI_PATH/raw/pipeline-context.json')).get('stage_c',{}).get('run_id','unknown'))")" \
  --tg-token-env "${TG_TOKEN_ENV:-YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_TOKEN}" \
  --tg-chat-id "${TG_CHAT_ID:-6938920500}"
```

3. 干预前后各发一条 TG 告知（使用脚本的 `send_tg` 或直接 curl）

---

## Pitfalls

### 0. git ls-files 俄文/中文文件名导致 FileNotFoundError
当 wiki/sources 目录下的文件名包含非 ASCII 字符（如中文）时，`git ls-files` 默认会为这些文件添加引号和转义，导致 Python `Path / filename` 拼接出错（FileNotFoundError）。修复方法：`git ls-files` 加 `-z` 参数（NUL 分隔），然后用 `\0` split 代替 `splitlines()`。

### 1. uncertain 频繁出现
说明 wiki 文件系统状态不一致（如手动操作遗留文件）。用 `git -C $WIKI_PATH status` 查看脏文件并清理。

### 2. TG 未发送（tg_sent: false）
检查 `~/.agent-brain-plugins.env` 里 `YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_TOKEN` 是否有效：
`curl -s "https://api.telegram.org/bot${YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_TOKEN}/getMe"`

### 3. brain push 失败
检查 `~/agent-brain-plugins` 的 git remote 和 token：
`git -C ~/agent-brain-plugins remote -v`

# SOP Pipeline Watchdog

## 触发条件
cron 定时触发（默认每分钟）

## Phase 1: 执行

```bash
source ~/.agent-brain-plugins.env 2>/dev/null || true
# 先同步 wiki 到最新
WIKI_PATH=$(eval echo "${YOUTUBE_WIKI_LOCAL_PATH:-~/wiki/youtube-video-research-wiki}")
git -C "$WIKI_PATH" fetch origin main -q && git -C "$WIKI_PATH" reset --hard origin/main -q

# 调脚本处理所有确定性工作
python3 __SKILL_DIR__/scripts/sop_watchdog.py \
  --wiki-path "$WIKI_PATH" \
  --tg-token-env "${TG_TOKEN_ENV:-YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_TOKEN}" \
  --tg-chat-id "${TG_CHAT_ID:-6938920500}" \
  --brain-dir ~/agent-brain-plugins \
  --repo-url "${REPO_URL:-https://github.com/divanoo65/youtube-video-research-wiki}"
```

脚本自动完成：读多信号源 → 判断状态 → 发 TG → 更新 state → push brain repo

## Phase 2: 确认结果

检查脚本输出和退出码：
- 退出码 `0` + `"status": "completed|idle|stage_b_running|..."` → 任务完成，无需干预
- 退出码 `2` + `"status": "uncertain"` → 信号矛盾，进入 Phase 3 人工推理
- 退出码 `1` → 脚本错误，检查 TG token、wiki 路径、brain repo 权限

## Phase 3: agent 介入（仅 uncertain 时）

脚本返回 `uncertain` 说明信号矛盾（如 stage_c 显示完成但 wiki/sources 为空）。
此时 agent 读取脚本输出的 `signals` 字段，结合运行时上下文推理实际状态，然后：

1. 确定真实状态
2. 若需干预（stuck），执行对应操作：

```bash

  -d "{\"stage\":\"notebooklm-research\",\"wiki_local_path\":\"$WIKI_PATH\",\"run_id\":\"watchdog-retry-$(date +%s)\"}"

# Stage C 卡死 → 直接运行脚本

# Stage D 卡死 → 直接运行通知脚本
```

### 0. git ls-files 俄文/中文文件名导致 FileNotFoundError
当 wiki/sources 目录下的文件名包含非 ASCII 字符（如中文）时，`git ls-files` 默认会为这些文件添加引号和转义，导致 Python `Path / filename` 拼接出错（FileNotFoundError）。修复方法：`git ls-files` 加 `-z` 参数（NUL 分隔），然后用 `\0` split 代替 `splitlines()`。

{"content": "     1|#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2|"""
     3|SOP Pipeline Watchdog Script v3
     4|信号源：git log [pipe:xxx] 阶段间状态 + 历史耗时自适应阈值
     5|判断逻辑：当前阶段 + 已用时 vs 历史基准 → 是否干预
     6|"""
     7|import argparse, json, os, re, subprocess, sys
     8|from datetime import datetime, timezone
     9|from pathlib import Path
    10|
    11|
    12|# ── 步骤模式 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    13|
    14|STEP_PATTERNS = {
    15|    1: re.compile(r'^feat: queue .+ \[pipe:'),     # Dify push
    16|    2: re.compile(r'^chore: stage-b done'),         # Stage B done
    17|    3: re.compile(r'^chore: stage-c done'),         # Stage C done
    18|    4: re.compile(r'^chore: stage-d done'),         # Stage D done
    19|}
    20|
    21|STEP_NAMES = {1: "stage_b", 2: "stage_c", 3: "stage_d", 4: "completed"}
    22|
    23|
    24|# ── git log 读取 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    25|
    26|def read_git_log(wiki_path: Path, limit: int = 100) -> list[dict]:
    27|    """读取最近 N 条 commit，返回 [{ts, sha, msg, pipeline_id, run_id, step}]"""
    28|    r = subprocess.run(
    29|        ["git", "log", f"--max-count={limit}", "--format=%ct|%H|%s"],
    30|        cwd=wiki_path, capture_output=True, text=True
    31|    )
    32|    commits = []
    33|    for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
    34|        parts = line.split("|", 2)
    35|        if len(parts) != 3:
    36|            continue
    37|        ts_str, sha, msg = parts
    38|        ts = int(ts_str)
    39|
    40|        pipe_m = re.search(r'\[pipe:([^\]]+)\]', msg)
    41|        run_m  = re.search(r'\[run:([^\]]+)\]',  msg)
    42|        step = next((s for s, pat in STEP_PATTERNS.items() if pat.search(msg)), None)
    43|
    44|        commits.append({
    45|            "ts": ts, "sha": sha[:8], "msg": msg,
    46|            "pipeline_id": pipe_m.group(1) if pipe_m else None,
    47|            "run_id":      run_m.group(1)  if run_m  else None,
    48|            "step":        step,
    49|        })
    50|    return commits
    51|
    52|
    53|def group_by_pipeline(commits: list[dict]) -> dict:
    54|    """按 pipeline_id 分组，返回 {pipeline_id: {steps: {step: commit}, latest_ts}}"""
    55|    pipelines = {}
    56|    for c in commits:
    57|        pid = c.get("pipeline_id")
    58|        if not pid or c["step"] is None:
    59|            continue
    60|        if pid not in pipelines:
    61|            pipelines[pid] = {"steps": {}, "latest_ts": 0}
    62|        if c["step"] not in pipelines[pid]["steps"]:  # 只记录最新的同类 commit
    63|            pipelines[pid]["steps"][c["step"]] = c
    64|        pipelines[pid]["latest_ts"] = max(pipelines[pid]["latest_ts"], c["ts"])
    65|    return pipelines
    66|
    67|
    68|# ── 历史耗时读取 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    69|
    70|def load_historical_thresholds(wiki_path: Path) -> dict:
    71|    """
    72|    从 logs/pipeline-runs/*.json 读取历史耗时
    73|    返回自适应阈值（P75 * 2，单位：分钟）
    74|    最少保留 5 分钟宽限期
    75|    """
    76|    archives_dir = wiki_path / "logs" / "pipeline-runs"
    77|    durations = {"stage_b": [], "stage_c": [], "stage_d": [30]}  # stage_d 默认30s
    78|
    79|    if archives_dir.exists():
    80|        for f in sorted(archives_dir.glob("*.json"))[-30:]:  # 最近30次
    81|            try:
    82|                data = json.loads(f.read_text())
    83|                for stage in ("stage_b", "stage_c"):
    84|                    d = data.get(stage, {}).get("duration_s")
    85|                    if d and isinstance(d, (int, float)) and d > 0:
    86|                        durations[stage].append(d)
    87|            except Exception:
    88|                pass
    89|
    90|    def adaptive(samples: list, fallback_min: int) -> int:
    91|        if len(samples) < 3:
    92|            return fallback_min
    93|        sorted_s = sorted(samples)
    94|        p75 = sorted_s[int(len(sorted_s) * 0.75)]
    95|        threshold_min = max(5, int(p75 * 2 / 60))  # P75*2，最少5分钟
    96|        return threshold_min
    97|
    98|    return {
    99|        "stage_b": adaptive(durations["stage_b"], fallback_min=15),
   100|        "stage_c": adaptive(durations["stage_c"], fallback_min=30),
   101|        "stage_d": 10,  # TG 通知很快，固定10分钟
   102|    }
   103|

   114|    if 4 in steps:

   116|                "elapsed_min": 0, "threshold_min": 0,
   117|                "should_intervene": False, "reason": "stage-d done commit 已出现"}
   118|
   119|    if not steps:
   120|        return {"status": "unknown", "current_stage": "unknown",
   121|                "elapsed_min": 0, "threshold_min": 0,
   122|                "should_intervene": False, "reason": "无可识别步骤"}

   124|    # 当前阶段 = 最后完成步骤的下一阶段
   125|    current_stage = STEP_NAMES.get(max_step + 1, f"step_{max_step+1}")
   126|    last_commit_ts = steps[max_step]["ts"]

   128|    threshold_min = thresholds.get(current_stage, 30)

{"path": "/tmp/debug_watchdog.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Debug: show what the watchdog script sees for pipeline grouping."""
import json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wiki_path = Path("/home/zhouhuijuan1987/wiki/youtube-video-research-wiki")

STEP_PATTERNS = {
    1: re.compile(r'^feat: queue .+ \[pipe:'),
    2: re.compile(r'^chore: stage-b done'),
    3: re.compile(r'^chore: stage-c done'),
    4: re.compile(r'^chore: stage-d done'),
}
STEP_NAMES = {1: "stage_b", 2: "stage_c", 3: "stage_d", 4: "completed"}

r = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "log", f"--max-count=100", "--format=%ct|%H|%s"],
    cwd=wiki_path, capture_output=True, text=True
)
commits = []
for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
    parts = line.split("|", 2)
    if len(parts) != 3:
        continue
    ts_str, sha, msg = parts
    ts = int(ts_str)
    pipe_m = re.search(r'\[pipe:([^\]]+)\]', msg)
    run_m  = re.search(r'\[run:([^\]]+)\]', msg)
    step = next((s for s, pat in STEP_PATTERNS.items() if pat.search(msg)), None)
    commits.append({
        "ts": ts, "sha": sha[:8], "msg": msg[:80],
        "pipeline_id": pipe_m.group(1) if pipe_m else None,
        "run_id": run_m.group(1) if run_m else None,
        "step": step,
    })

# Group by pipeline
pipelines = {}
for c in commits:
    pid = c.get("pipeline_id")
    if not pid or c["step"] is None:
        continue
    if pid not in pipelines:
        pipelines[pid] = {"steps": {}, "latest_ts": 0}
    if c["step"] not in pipelines[pid]["steps"]:
        pipelines[pid]["steps"][c["step"]] = c
    pipelines[pid]["latest_ts"] = max(pipelines[pid]["latest_ts"], c["ts"])

# Show all pipeline groups
for pid in sorted(pipelines.keys()):
    p = pipelines[pid]
    steps = p["steps"]
    max_step = max(steps.keys())
    current_stage = STEP_NAMES.get(max_step + 1, f"step_{max_step+1}")
    print(f"\n=== {pid} ===")
    print(f"  Steps: {sorted(steps.keys())} (max={max_step})")
    print(f"  Current stage: {current_stage}")
    for step_num in sorted(steps.keys()):
        c = steps[step_num]
        print(f"    Step {step_num}: {c['msg']}")
    print(f"  Latest ts: {p['latest_ts']}")
"}

# Harness

Harness 是一套工程化的 AI 代理驾驭框架，其核心理念是**将复杂的、多步骤的 AI 任务抽象为可复用的“Skill”（技能）**。该框架并非通过简单的 Prompt 指令驱动模型，而是通过显式的流程控制、状态管理、约束与恢复机制、自检修复回路以及上下文管理，将模型能力“驾驭”起来，从而在不同场景下产出稳定、高质量的结果。在 Harness 的体系下，一个 Skill 被拆分为若干明确定义的子步骤（如输入解析、计划制定、执行、评估、修复等），每个步骤均可由不同的工具或子代理（Agent）完成，并配有检查点和人工审核点，确保最终输出的可靠性与可控性。这种设计使得开发者能够系统性地应对大语言模型的不确定性，将单次 Prompt 的随机性转化为可预测的生产流程。
---

## 在本视频中的角色

在视频《Harness 实践：Agent 全自动知识讲解视频生成技术简报》中，Harness 作为整个技术方案的**核心底层架构**，贯穿了从「口播稿改写」到「网页动态效果编写」再到「语音合成」的全部环节。视频详细展示了如何通过 Harness 框架设计一个名为 **“Web Video Presentation”** 的 Skill，并指挥 AI Agent（如 [[Claude Code]]）按照预设流程自动生成知识讲解视频。Harness 提供的流程控制、状态记忆和自检修复能力，确保了不同主题、不同背景下的视频产出高度稳定一致，从而证明了“驾驭工程”而非单纯依赖模型能力才是实现全自动视频生成的关键。视频中反复出现的“[[驾驭工程]]”概念，正是 Harness 世界观的具体体现。

# Harness 实践：Agent 全自动知识讲解视频生成技术简报

## 一、 执行摘要

当前 AI 视频生成领域虽发展迅速，但在精细化、可控性及成本方面仍存在挑战。本方案避开了直接使用视频生成模型或 NotebookLM 等工具，转而采用 **Web Coding（网页编码）** 的方式生成视频内容。通过在 [[Harness]] 框架下设计的 **“Web Video Presentation” Skill**，开发者可以指挥 AI Agent（如 [[Claude Code]]）完成口播稿改写、开发大纲制定、网页动态效果编写及语音合成。该流程的核心价值在于通过工程化手段（流程控制、状态管理、自检修复）驾驭模型能力，确保不同主题、不同背景下的视频产出具有高度的稳定性和一致性。

## 二、 核心要点

本技术简报的核心价值在于揭示了一条不同于主流“视频模型直接生成”的工程化路径。作者明确指出，视频生成模型虽在快速发展，但在字体配色、节奏控制、精确数字呈现等细节上难以满足专业制作者的需求。因此，方案选择了 **网页编码** 作为载体，利用 HTML/CSS/JS 的绝对可控性，实现了“改几行代码就能调整画面”的灵活性。这种思路本质上是对 [[驾驭工程]] 理念的实践：不是抛弃模型，而是通过一套严谨的 **Skill** 系统对模型能力进行约束和编排，将模型、工具和人的判断整合成一条稳定可控的生产流水线。

在 Skill 设计层面，方案拆解出六个核心组件：上下文管理（通过分文档读取避免注意力稀释）、工具系统（Agent 自带文件读写结合外部 CLI）、执行与编排（四阶段流程+人工检查点）、状态与记忆（依赖 `outline.md` 保持长链路连续性）、评估与观测（独立的 Reviewer Agent 进行硬性自检）、约束与恢复（贯彻 **“最小切片修复”** 原则，出错时仅修改受影响的代码层级，避免全量重作带来的副作用）。这种结构化的工程思维，使得 Agent 在面对不同主题的长视频制作时，能够稳定输出高质量成果。

技术栈方面，核心 Agent 选择 [[Claude Code]]（兼容 [[Cursor]] / [[Codex]]），底层语音和部分多模态能力由 [[MiniMax]]（推荐 2.7 版本）提供，通过 [[CC Switch]] 切换底层模型，使用 [[MiniMax CLI]] 批量合成音频。环境管理采用 [[TMUX]] 多终端以便观察 Agent Teams 协作。视频生产被严格划分为四个阶段：内容编写与规划（口播稿改写+开发大纲）、网页开发与验证（基准章节先行+并行开发+物理隔离）、语音合成（TTS 批量生成）、录制与产出（手动/音频/全自动三种模式）。其中“全自动模式”通过页面按音频节奏自动翻页和展示动效，实现了真正的一键录屏。

Signals to look for (any one of these warrants action):
  • User corrected your style, tone, format, legibility, or verbosity. Frustration signals like 'stop doing X', 'this is too verbose', 'don't format like this', 'why are you explaining', 'just give me the answer', 'you always do Y and I hate it', or an explicit 'remember this' are FIRST-CLASS skill signals, not just memory signals. Update the relevant skill(s) to embed the preference so the next session starts already knowing.
  • User corrected your workflow, approach, or sequence of steps. Encode the correction as a pitfall or explicit step in the skill that governs that class of task.
  • Non-trivial technique, fix, workaround, debugging path, or tool-usage pattern emerged that a future session would benefit from. Capture it.
  • A skill that got loaded or consulted this session turned out to be wrong, missing a step, or outdated. Patch it NOW.

Preference order — prefer the earliest action that fits, but do pick one when a signal above fired:
  1. UPDATE A CURRENTLY-LOADED SKILL. Look back through the conversation for skills the user loaded via /skill-name or you read via skill_view. If any of them covers the territory of the new learning, PATCH that one first. It is the skill that was in play, so it's the right one to extend.
  2. UPDATE AN EXISTING UMBRELLA (via skills_list + skill_view). If no loaded skill fits but an existing class-level skill does, patch it. Add a subsection, a pitfall, or broaden a trigger.
  3. ADD A SUPPORT FILE under an existing umbrella. Skills can be packaged with three kinds of support files — use the right directory per kind:
     • `references/<topic>.md` — session-specific detail (error transcripts, reproduction recipes, provider quirks) AND condensed knowledge banks: quoted research, API docs, external authoritative excerpts, or domain notes you found while working on the problem. Write it concise and for the value of the task, not as a full mirror of upstream docs.
     • `templates/<name>.<ext>` — starter files meant to be copied and modified (boilerplate configs, scaffolding, a known-good example the agent can `reproduce with modifications`).
     • `scripts/<name>.<ext>` — statically re-runnable actions the skill can invoke directly (verification scripts, fixture generators, deterministic probes, anything the agent should run rather than hand-type each time).
     Add support files via skill_manage action=write_file with file_path starting 'references/', 'templates/', or 'scripts/'. The umbrella's SKILL.md should gain a one-line pointer to any new support file so future agents know it exists.
  4. CREATE A NEW CLASS-LEVEL UMBRELLA SKILL when no existing skill covers the class. The name MUST be at the class level. The name MUST NOT be a specific PR number, error string, feature codename, library-alone name, or 'fix-X / debug-Y / audit-Z-today' session artifact. If the proposed name only makes sense for today's task, it's wrong — fall back to (1), (2), or (3).

import argparse, json, os, re, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path


# ── 步骤模式 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

STEP_PATTERNS = {
    1: re.compile(r'^feat: queue .+ \[pipe:'),     # Dify push
    2: re.compile(r'^chore: stage-b done'),         # Stage B done
    3: re.compile(r'^chore: stage-c done'),         # Stage C done
    4: re.compile(r'^chore: stage-d done'),         # Stage D done
}

STEP_NAMES = {1: "stage_b", 2: "stage_c", 3: "stage_d", 4: "completed"}


# ── git log 读取 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def read_git_log(wiki_path: Path, limit: int = 100) -> list[dict]:
    """读取最近 N 条 commit，返回 [{ts, sha, msg, pipeline_id, run_id, step}]"""
    r = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "log", f"--max-count={limit}", "--format=%ct|%H|%s"],
        cwd=wiki_path, capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    commits = []
    for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
        parts = line.split("|", 2)
        if len(parts) != 3:
            continue
        ts_str, sha, msg = parts
        ts = int(ts_str)

        pipe_m = re.search(r'\[pipe:([^\]]+)\]', msg)
        run_m  = re.search(r'\[run:([^\]]+)\]',  msg)
        step = next((s for s, pat in STEP_PATTERNS.items() if pat.search(msg)), None)

        commits.append({
            "ts": ts, "sha": sha[:8], "msg": msg,
            "pipeline_id": pipe_m.group(1) if pipe_m else None,
            "run_id":      run_m.group(1)  if run_m  else None,
            "step":        step,
        })
    return commits


def group_by_pipeline(commits: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """按 pipeline_id 分组，返回 {pipeline_id: {steps: {step: commit}, latest_ts}}"""
    pipelines = {}
    for c in commits:
        pid = c.get("pipeline_id")
        if not pid or c["step"] is None:
            continue
        if pid not in pipelines:
            pipelines[pid] = {"steps": {}, "latest_ts": 0}
        if c["step"] not in pipelines[pid]["steps"]:  # 只记录最新的同类 commit
            pipelines[pid]["steps"][c["step"]] = c
        pipelines[pid]["latest_ts"] = max(pipelines[pid]["latest_ts"], c["ts"])
    return pipelines


# ── 历史耗时读取 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_historical_thresholds(wiki_path: Path) -> dict:
    """
    从 logs/pipeline-runs/*.json 读取历史耗时
    返回自适应阈值（P75 * 2，单位：分钟）
    最少保留 5 分钟宽限期
    """
    archives_dir = wiki_path / "logs" / "pipeline-runs"
    durations = {"stage_b": [], "stage_c": [], "stage_d": [30]}  # stage_d 默认30s

    if archives_dir.exists():
        for f in sorted(archives_dir.glob("*.json"))[-30:]:  # 最近30次
            try:
                data = json.loads(f.read_text())
                for stage in ("stage_b", "stage_c"):
                    d = data.get(stage, {}).get("duration_s")
                    if d and isinstance(d, (int, float)) and d > 0:
                        durations[stage].append(d)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def adaptive(samples: list, fallback_min: int) -> int:
        if len(samples) < 3:
            return fallback_min
        sorted_s = sorted(samples)
        p75 = sorted_s[int(len(sorted_s) * 0.75)]
        threshold_min = max(5, int(p75 * 2 / 60))  # P75*2，最少5分钟
        return threshold_min

    return {
        "stage_b": adaptive(durations["stage_b"], fallback_min=15),
        "stage_c": adaptive(durations["stage_c"], fallback_min=30),
        "stage_d": 10,  # TG 通知很快，固定10分钟
    }


# ── 状态判断 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def judge_pipeline(pipeline: dict, thresholds: dict, now_ts: int) -> dict:
    """
    返回 {status, current_stage, elapsed_min, threshold_min, should_intervene, reason}
    """
    steps = pipeline["steps"]
    max_step = max(steps.keys()) if steps else 0

    if 4 in steps:
        return {"status": "completed", "current_stage": "done",
                "elapsed_min": 0, "threshold_min": 0,
                "should_intervene": False, "reason": "stage-d done commit 已出现"}

    if not steps:
        return {"status": "unknown", "current_stage": "unknown",
                "elapsed_min": 0, "threshold_min": 0,
                "should_intervene": False, "reason": "无可识别步骤"}

    # 当前阶段 = 最后完成步骤的下一阶段
    current_stage = STEP_NAMES.get(max_step + 1, f"step_{max_step+1}")
    last_commit_ts = steps[max_step]["ts"]
    elapsed_min = int((now_ts - last_commit_ts) / 60)
    threshold_min = thresholds.get(current_stage, 30)

    # 历史基准信息（用于 TG 展示）
    historical_note = f"历史基准: P75×2 = {threshold_min}min"

    if elapsed_min > threshold_min:
        return {
            "status": "stuck",
            "current_stage": current_stage,
            "elapsed_min": elapsed_min,
            "threshold_min": threshold_min,
            "should_intervene": True,
            "reason": f"{current_stage} 已 {elapsed_min}min，超过阈值 {threshold_min}min（{historical_note}）"
        }
    else:
        return {
            "status": "running",
            "current_stage": current_stage,
            "elapsed_min": elapsed_min,
            "threshold_min": threshold_min,
            "should_intervene": False,
            "reason": f"{current_stage} 运行中 {elapsed_min}min / {threshold_min}min（{historical_note}）"
        }


# ── TG 消息（固定格式）────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def build_tg_message(active_pipelines: list, idle_since: str,
                     patrol_count: int, repo_url: str) -> str:
    now_str = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    lines = [f"[🐕 WATCHDOG] {now_str} 巡航 #{patrol_count}", ""]

    if not active_pipelines:
        lines += ["💤 无活跃 pipeline", f"   上次完成: {idle_since}"]
        return "\n".join(lines)

    for p in active_pipelines:
        status = p["judgment"]
        pid    = p["pipeline_id"]
        stage  = status["current_stage"]
        elapsed = status["elapsed_min"]
        threshold = status["threshold_min"]
        pct = min(100, int(elapsed / threshold * 100)) if threshold else 0

        if status["status"] == "completed":
            src_title = p.get("source_title", "")
            src_url   = p.get("source_url", "")
            src_gh    = f"{repo_url}/blob/main/wiki/sources/{p.get('source_stem','')}.md" if repo_url and p.get("source_stem") else ""
            lines += [
                "✅ Pipeline 完成",
                f"   📹 {src_title}" if src_title else f"   pipe: {pid}",
            ]
            if src_url:   lines.append(f"   🔗 {src_url}")
            if src_gh:    lines.append(f"   📄 {src_gh}")

        elif status["status"] == "stuck":
            lines += [
                f"⚠️ {stage} 疑似卡死",
                f"   pipe: {pid}",
                f"   已运行: {elapsed}min（阈值: {threshold}min）",
                f"   🔧 即将干预...",
            ]
        else:
            bar = "█" * (pct // 10) + "░" * (10 - pct // 10)
            lines += [
                f"🟡 {stage} 运行中",
                f"   pipe: {pid}",
                f"   [{bar}] {elapsed}/{threshold}min",
            ]
        lines.append("")

    return "\n".join(lines).rstrip()


# ── TG 发送 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def send_tg(token: str, chat_id: str, text: str) -> bool:
    r = subprocess.run([
        "curl", "-s", "-X", "POST",
        f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/sendMessage",
        "-d", f"chat_id={chat_id}",
        "-d", "disable_web_page_preview=true",
        "--data-urlencode", f"text={text}",
        "-w", "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}"
    ], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return "HTTP_STATUS:200" in r.stdout


# ── State 持久化 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def update_state_and_push(brain_dir: Path, status: str, patrol_count: int) -> int:
    state_file = brain_dir / "youtube-wiki" / "watchdog" / "state.json"
    state_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    state = {}
    if state_file.exists():
        try: state = json.loads(state_file.read_text())
        except: pass
    new_count = state.get("patrol_count", 0) + 1
    state.update({"patrol_count": new_count,
                   "last_patrol_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
                   "last_status": status})
    state_file.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=brain_dir)
    diff = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--cached", "--quiet"], cwd=brain_dir)
    if diff.returncode != 0:
        subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m",
                        f"watchdog: patrol #{new_count} - {status}"], cwd=brain_dir)
        subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], cwd=brain_dir)
    return new_count


# ── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--wiki-path",    required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--tg-token-env", default="YOUTUBE_WIKI_TG_TOKEN")
    parser.add_argument("--tg-chat-id",   required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--brain-dir",    default=str(Path.home() / "agent-brain-plugins"))
    parser.add_argument("--repo-url",     default="")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    wiki_path = Path(args.wiki_path).expanduser()
    brain_dir = Path(args.brain_dir).expanduser()
    tg_token  = os.environ.get(args.tg_token_env, "")
    now_ts    = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

    # 1. git sync
    subprocess.run(["git", "fetch", "origin", "main", "-q"], cwd=wiki_path)
    subprocess.run(["git", "reset", "--hard", "origin/main", "-q"], cwd=wiki_path)

    # 2. 读 git log，按 pipeline_id 分组
    commits   = read_git_log(wiki_path)
    pipelines = group_by_pipeline(commits)

    # 3. 读历史耗时，计算自适应阈值
    thresholds = load_historical_thresholds(wiki_path)

    # 4. 找最近5个 pipeline，判断状态
    recent = sorted(pipelines.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["latest_ts"], reverse=True)[:5]
    active_pipelines = []
    overall_status = "idle"

    for pid, pipeline_data in recent:
        judgment = judge_pipeline(pipeline_data, thresholds, now_ts)
        entry = {"pipeline_id": pid, "judgment": judgment}
        active_pipelines.append(entry)
        if judgment["status"] in ("running", "stuck"):
            overall_status = judgment["status"]

    # 5. 更新 patrol count
    state_file = brain_dir / "youtube-wiki" / "watchdog" / "state.json"
    state = {}
    if state_file.exists():
        try: state = json.loads(state_file.read_text())
        except: pass
    patrol_count = state.get("patrol_count", 0) + 1

    # 6. 发 TG
    idle_since = recent[0][0] if recent else "unknown"
    tg_msg = build_tg_message(active_pipelines, idle_since, patrol_count, args.repo_url)
    tg_ok = send_tg(tg_token, args.tg_chat_id, tg_msg) if tg_token else False

    # 7. 写 state + push brain
    update_state_and_push(brain_dir, overall_status, patrol_count)

    # 8. 输出结果
    result = {
        "status": overall_status,
        "patrol_count": patrol_count,
        "tg_sent": tg_ok,
        "thresholds_min": thresholds,
        "pipelines": [
            {"id": p["pipeline_id"], "status": p["judgment"]["status"],
             "stage": p["judgment"]["current_stage"],
             "elapsed_min": p["judgment"]["elapsed_min"],
             "should_intervene": p["judgment"]["should_intervene"]}
            for p in active_pipelines
        ]
    }
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))

    # uncertain = 有需要干预的 → exit(2) 让 agent 介入
    needs_intervention = any(p["judgment"]["should_intervene"] for p in active_pipelines)
    sys.exit(2 if needs_intervention else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

## Dead Pipeline Detection

Pipeline `4kgkYAGPuD0` had queue commits but the video link file was deleted:

```bash
# Check if link file exists
ls raw/youtube-links/<video_id>.md

# Check git history for deletion
git log --all --diff-filter=D -- "raw/youtube-links/<video_id>*"
```

When the link file was removed by a `chore: clean slate` or similar cleanup commit, the pipeline cannot proceed through Stage B (NotebookLM). Create empty commits to close:

```bash
for pid in "${PIPELINE_IDS[@]}"; do
  git commit --allow-empty -m "chore: stage-b done [pipe:${pid}] [run:watchdog-cleanup-$(date +%s)]"
  git commit --allow-empty -m "chore: stage-c done [pipe:${pid}] [run:watchdog-cleanup-$(date +%s)]"
  git commit --allow-empty -m "chore: stage-d done [pipe:${pid}] [run:watchdog-cleanup-$(date +%s)]"
done
git push origin main
```

## Duplicate Pipelines (Same Video, Multiple Runs)

When a video is queued twice (e.g., `0hM2SkHZ2UU-20260513T101233` and `0hM2SkHZ2UU-20260513T100716`), only one pipeline gets processed. The other is a stale/duplicate. Resolution: advance the stale one through all stages with empty commits, since its analysis is already handled by the other pipeline.

## Stage C Builder Skip Behavior

`sop_wiki_builder_v3.py` skips analysis reports whose source pages already exist in `wiki/sources/`. When a previous pipeline (different run_id) already created the source page, the new pipeline's stage_c builder exits early without creating a `stage-c done` commit. The agent must either:
1. Manually create the `stage-c done` commit, or
2. Update `pipeline-context.json` first, then run the stage D notifier
